evals.prompt: Map this codebase and produce the full docs/codebase knowledge base.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs scripts/scan.py first, then reads intent documents (README, ARCHITECTURE, top-level docs) before opening any source files, following the four-phase checklist in order.
assertions: Runs `python3 skills/acquire-codebase-knowledge/scripts/scan.py --output docs/codebase/.codebase-scan.txt` (or the repo's equivalent skills path) before reading source files
Reads README/intent documents (PRD, TRD, ROADMAP, SPEC, DESIGN) and summarizes stated project intent before reading source code
Follows the checklist phases (scan, investigate, populate, validate) in order rather than skipping to populating docs
deterministic_checks: `python3 skills/acquire-codebase-knowledge/scripts/scan.py --output docs/codebase/.codebase-scan.txt` runs before other file reads

evals.prompt: Onboard me to this repo - create the full codebase knowledge base.
evals.expected_behavior: Produces exactly the seven required documents in docs/codebase/ with evidence lists citing concrete file paths, marks unknowns [TODO] and intent-dependent items [ASK USER] instead of guessing, and ends with a numbered [ASK USER] list.
assertions: Creates exactly STACK.md, STRUCTURE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CONVENTIONS.md, INTEGRATIONS.md, TESTING.md, CONCERNS.md in docs/codebase/
Every non-trivial claim has an evidence file-path citation
Unknowns are marked [TODO] and intent-dependent items are marked [ASK USER] rather than assumed
Final response lists [ASK USER] items as numbered questions and calls out any intent-vs-reality divergence

evals.prompt: Document only the architecture and testing layers of this codebase - I don't need the rest right now.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs Phase 1 scan in full, fully completes ARCHITECTURE.md and TESTING.md first, and keeps the other five documents present but marked [TODO] rather than fully investigating every area.
assertions: Fully completes ARCHITECTURE.md and TESTING.md before the non-focus documents
Non-focus documents keep required sections present but marked [TODO] rather than being fully researched
Still runs Phase 1 (scan + intent documents) in full even in focus-area mode
Still runs the Phase 4 validation loop across all seven documents before finishing

evals.prompt: Before I touch the payments module, map the files and tests I'll need to read.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to context-map for a targeted pre-edit file/test scoping pass instead of producing the full seven-document codebase knowledge base.
assertions: Does not create the seven docs/codebase files for a narrow pre-edit scoping request
Routes to context-map for the targeted file/test map instead

evals.prompt: What does the formatPrice function in src/utils/currency.ts do?
evals.expected_behavior: Answers directly by reading the single file rather than running the acquire-codebase-knowledge scan-and-document workflow.
assertions: Reads the single named file directly instead of running scripts/scan.py or building docs/codebase
Does not create any files under docs/codebase for a single-function question
